readme.markdown:
# font-metadata-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: font-metadata. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/font-metadata

toolsPreview.name: get_font_info
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific web font including variants, subsets, tags, designer, year, and Google Fonts URL.

toolsPreview.name: suggest_pairings
toolsPreview.description: Get font pairing recommendations with CSS snippets, compatibility scores, and curated rationale from design experts.

toolsPreview.name: generate_css
toolsPreview.description: Generate ready-to-use CSS @import snippet for a single font or a heading+body font pairing.

toolsPreview.name: list_fonts_by_category
toolsPreview.description: List available web fonts filtered by category, tag, or search query. Returns 100+ fonts across serif, sans-serif, monospace, display, and handwriting categories.

toolsPreview.name: check_language_support
toolsPreview.description: Check which languages/scripts a font supports, or verify support for specific language codes.

toolsPreview.name: font_stack
toolsPreview.description: Generate a complete CSS font-stack with metric-compatible and system fallbacks for robust cross-platform rendering.
